name: io.github.voronkovd/nux-mg30-mcp
title: NUX MG-30
description: Control a NUX MG-30 guitar processor over USB MIDI: amps, effects, knobs and presets.

environmentVariables.name: MG30_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Substring of the MIDI port name (default: auto-detect)

environmentVariables.name: MG30_CHANNEL
environmentVariables.description: MIDI channel set on the device, 1-16 (default 1)

environmentVariables.name: MG30_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where backups, patch files and logs are stored (default ~/.nux-mg30-mcp)
